name: Residence Card for Family Members of a Resident Foreigner

requirements.blocker_text: No distinct 'regroupement familial' (family reunification) legal category was found for Niger -- a dedicated search returned only French domestic-law material, mirroring the same structural absence found for Mali. Under Ordinance No. 2025-02, a joining spouse or family member is classified as an ordinary 'immigrant' (Article 11) and must obtain their own residence permit or resident card within 3 months of entry (Article 5), on the same general terms as any other foreigner. A person hosting a foreign family member, paid or not, must also notify local police of the arrangement or face penalties.
requirements.fix_path: Have the joining family member apply for their own residence card under the general immigrant regime; the host in Niger must also notify local police of the arrangement.

outcome.duration_length: resident card, renewable, exact validity not specified in the sources reviewed

sources.title: UNHCR Rights Mapping and Analysis Platform -- Ordinance No. 2025-02, Articles 5 and 11 (general immigrant residence-card regime) and the housing-notification requirement
